newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa says not selling BNP, Paribas stakes.
newsitem.headline: Axa says not selling BNP, Paribas stakes.

text.p: Axa chairman Claude Bebear said on Wednesday that the new Axa-UAP insurance group was not considering withdrawing from the capital of Banque Nationale de Paris or financial group Paribas.

"I know there's talk in the market that we might sell our BNP and Paribas shares. No. If that is to happen one day, it would be in agreement with the managements of those companies," Bebear told an extraordinary shareholders' meeting.
He said it was important not to destabilise companies through abrupt disengagements, but he added that Axa-UAP had no intention of being "the godfather of the French economy" through shareholdings.
He said the group would study its share stakes and investment would be driven by the interests of the company.
